tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Attach an experience certificate for the supply of the requested medicines to government institutions and other authorized organizations during any one of the years 2023-24, 2024-25, or 2025-26.

Tenderers must clearly state and attach their organizations name and full postal address (including mobile number, office telephone number, and e-mail address) on their agency/organizations letterhead.
Attach proof of payment of the EMD amount of Rs. 60,000/- (calculated at 2% of the total tender value) via the e-portal.
Attach the organizations Udyam Registration Certificate obtained from the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India.
Attach a copy of the Trade License Certificate.
Attach the original manufacturers license.
Attach a copy of the valid WHO GMP / GMP certificate held by the medicine manufacturing company.

In the case of authorized suppliers, attach an authorization letter from the concerned manufacturing company or wholesaler for the sale of Ayurvedic medicines, along with a copy of the manufacturing companys valid WHO GMP / GMP certificate.
Attach a copy of the GST Registration Certificate.
Attach a copy of the PAN Card in the name of the firm or proprietor.
Attach copies of the Tax Clearance Certificate for the 2025-26 financial year from the Commercial Taxes Department.
Attach records of income tax payments made during the years 2024-25, 2025-26, and 2026-27 (Assessment Years only).
Please attach copies of GST payment challans and the corresponding GST-3B forms for the six-month period of the 2026-27 financial year (from March 2026 to August 2026).
Attach the list of submitted drug samples.
Attach the test reports for the drug samples
Rates for the drugs must be quoted in accordance with the specifications in Annexure-1 of the financial bid.
Tenderers must attach documents proving that they possess a registered office and a medicine storage warehouse within Karnataka.

Tenderers must attach a self-declaration (as per Annexure-3) on a Rs. 100 stamp paper, stating that they have not been blacklisted by any organization in Karnataka or any other state during the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26.
It is mandatory to scan and upload the documents requested in the Technical Bid.
Attach details of annual turnover for the years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26 (Financial Years only), certified by a Chartered Accountant.
